ground_truth.title: Houston Humane Society
ground_truth.main_content:
The Houston Humane Society is dedicated to ending animal cruelty, abuse & the overpopulation of animals in Houston, Sugar Land, Houston Metro Area.

Our Vision
To lead the way in creating a more humane Greater Houston, where every pet is safe in a loving home and every wild animal thrives in its natural habitat.

Adopt a Pet
OPEN YOUR HEART, OPEN YOUR HOME In our community, there are thousands and thousands of animals without homes. When you adopt an animal from HHS, you are saving two lives, giving one animal a forever home and making space for a homeless pet at our animal shelter. If you're interested in our dog or cat adoptions, we welcome you to stop by our pet adoption center in Houston, TX today.

Clinic Services
The main goal of our Animal Wellness Clinic is to provide affordable and accessible veterinary services to pet owners in the greater Brazoria, Ft. Bend, Harris, and surrounding counties. Our animal clinic & friendly veterinary staff provides low-cost preventative animal services such as pet vaccinations, spay & neuter, pet surgery, dental care, and many more. Contact us today to learn more about our veterinary services, schedule an appointment, or stop by our walk-in animal clinic for the vet care your pet needs!

How You Can Help

Volunteer
Join our wonderful team of Volunteers at the Houston Humane Society. There are many opportunities at our shelter and clinic where you can help make a difference. Volunteer on your own or with a group! We are always recruiting new volunteers.

Foster
Help foster happiness in animals without a home. Be a foster, save a life. As a foster you are providing temporary housing for our most vulnerable, dogs, cats, puppies and kittens who need extra care outside of the shelter environment.
